reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

- **Source:** her own post in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. The morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note.
- **Not confirmed:** Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login. I couldn't find anything saying it was fixed, so I suggested she check with Hollis before marking it resolved in the account sheet.
- **gbrain:** the knowledge brain refused the search and returned nothing, because its connection isn't tied to any one member. I answered from #central-team, which Pree belongs to, and two Central team files anyone can read. To make gbrain work, whoever runs its host machine needs to tie the connection to a member with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`. I didn't try to change that myself.
